license: Apache-2.0
note: the two amalgamated files taken verbatim from the release zip (perfetto.h, perfetto.cc),
      generated upstream by tools/gen_amalgamated. Nothing edited here. Only the in-process
      backend is used; the client is engaged solely when ZUI_TRACE names a file, so a build that
      never asks for a trace never starts the SDK's service thread.
